name: Don't Look Away
source:
You wake up in a dimly lit, unfamiliar room. The air is thick, suffocating. In the farthest corner, a shadowy figure stands unnervingly still, its featureless face locked onto you. You don’t know how you got here. You don’t know what it wants. But as the flickering light overhead begins to wane, one thing becomes clear—it moves when you’re not looking.

A voice echoes in your mind, offering choices. Look away? Speak to it? Run? Every action shapes your fate, leading to one of six disturbing endings. But be careful—some things should never be seen.

Will you break the cycle? Or will you become the next shadow in the corner?

Whatever you do… don’t look away.

[From [url=https://hannah1496-yt.itch.io/dont-look-away]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一个光线昏暗、陌生的房间里醒来。空气粘稠，令人窒息。在最远的角落里，一个模糊的人影一动不动地站着，毫无特征的脸锁定了你。你不知道你是怎么来到这里的。你不知道它想要什么。但当头顶闪烁的灯光开始减弱时，一件事变得清晰起来——当你不看时，它会移动。

一个声音在你的脑海中回响，提供选择。把目光移开？跟它说话吗？跑步？每一个行动都会塑造你的命运，并导致六个令人不安的结局之一。但要小心——有些东西永远不应该被看到。

你会打破这个循环吗？或者你会成为角落里的下一个影子吗？

无论你做什么……都不要把目光移开。

[来自[url=https://hannah1496-yt.itch.io/dont-look-away]itch.io[/url]]
